reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 1771 for the 10626-receiver graph. Lower bound is an independent set of size 1771 (check passed); upper bound is a linear code M = I + A over F_2 whose length meets 1771, with code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all true. Only one code was tried (codes_tried 1), so the hypothesised K(24,4) structure led straight to the right field. Time: wall_s 55.043, of which llm_s 41.452 (about 75%) went to 2 LLM calls and 1 critic round, and compute_s was only 13.591. So the LLM, not computation, set the pace. No baselines were run, so accuracy and speed cannot be compared against them. Nothing looks suspicious, though own_rank is unavailable at N = 10626 > 2500.
